title: Jesus Is Moving Once Again
subtitle: A new mission with the Kona Ships program.
description: A June 2026 update about joining the Kona Ships program, continuing in missions, and the original fundraising plans.
subject: Jesus Is Moving Once Again | June 2026
previewText: Guys! Jesus is moving once again. I’m heading out on a new mission with Kona Ships.

cover.alt: A group standing together with surfboards on a beach.
cover.caption: Surfing and missions.

introduction.text: Guys! Jesus is moving once again. I am heading out on a new mission!
I’ve gotten the opportunity to join in with the Kona Ships program.

blocks.text: Taking this step allows me to continue pursuing the mission God has placed on my heart: bringing joy and light into the darkest corners of the world and being a father and a friend to millions of children across the nations.

blocks.alt: Logan sitting outside with a group of young people under a tree.
blocks.caption: Time with people—part of the heart behind this journey.

blocks.text: Archive note: The $14,500 goal and the estimates below were shared in this June 2026 update for the following six to eight months.
I need your help to raise $14,500. Here’s the breakdown:

On-Location Bible Course in Kona — $8,200
Needed by September 23.
Living costs for the Diakonos training course in Kona — $3,100.
I’m so grateful for all your support. I can’t do this without you guys!
I know God will provide, and I’m excited for this journey. Love you guys!
